data.Q: Who does Zebul say is mistaking shapes for people?
Where does Gaal first say people come from?
data.A: Gaal says from the high parts of the mountains.
data.wrong_answer: Gaal says from the central hill.

data.Q: Who speaks again after Zebul replies?
From where does Gaal say the company comes?
data.A: Gaal says from near the diviners’ tree.
data.wrong_answer: Gaal says from the central hill.
